name: Anti-Venom

abilityDetails.Disorient: Savunma yetenek doğruluğunu ve blok yeterliliğini belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Decelerate: Unstoppable ve Kaçış (Evade) yetenek doğruluğunu sabit bir miktarda azaltır.
abilityDetails.Stagger: Sendeletilen (Staggered) şampiyonlar bir sonraki kazandıkları buff'ı Nullify eder.
abilityDetails.Petrify: Düşmanın iyileşme ve güç kazanım hızını azaltır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.

signatureAbility:
Controlled Symbiosis
While the Opponent is suffering from the Klyntar Debuff, if Anti-Venom is struck by or Blocks a non-Critical Hit, he gains a Regeneration Passive that recovers [20 - 65]% of the hit damage taken over 20 seconds. These Regenerations are removed if the Klyntar Debuff is removed by Purify or Cleanse.
Each time Anti-Venom inflicts a personal Debuff, he inflicts an indefinite 2.5% Exacerbate Passive. Max stacks: 10.
Each personal Exacerbate Passive increases the potency of Anti-Venom's peronal Debuffs by an additonal 2.5%.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Immunity to Incinerate and Poison.
During the Opponent's Special Attacks Anti-Venom gains 40% Defensive Combat Rate per Debuff on the Opponent.
Personal Passives are paused during Special Attacks and for 5 seconds on Striker activation.

abilitySections.title: Genetic Memory
content: When the fight starts Anti-Venom inflicts an indefinite Klyntar Debuff. If this Debuff is removed by any means it comes back after 15 second(s).

If the Opponent is suffering from the Klyntar Debuff, every 10 times either Champion lands a hit, Anti-Venom inflicts the selected Genetic Memory Debuff from the list below. Max Genetic Memory Debuffs 4.
Spectre Debuff: Reduces the Opponent's Regeneration Rate by 16.66%
Disorient: Reduces Defensive Ability Accuracy and Block Proficiency by 12.5%.
Decelerate: Lowers Evade and Unstoppable Ability Accuracy by -33% flat.
Second Medium Attack changes the selected Genetic Memory Debuff to the next Debuff in the list. Defenders have a 50% chance to change the selection when inflicting a Genetic Memory Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Klyntar Debuff
content: Klyntar Debuff reduces Physical Resistance by [687.5] and gains additional properties based on Anti-Venom's Opponent.
#Spider-Verse Heroes: Reduce the Ability Accuracy of evade effects by 100%.
Mystic Champions: Reduce the Ability Accuracy of Unblockable effects by -65% flat. While 4 or more of Anti-Venom's personal Debuffs are active, this reduction becoms -100%.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Inflict a Stagger that lasts for 10 second(s). Max 2 Stacks.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: If not already active, gain an Accelerated Mutation Passive, causing Anti-Venom to inflict an additional Genetic Memory Debuff for 15 second(s). Triggering Accelerated Mutation also refreshes the Evolved Mutation Passive.
If Accelerated Mutation is active, all hits deal a burst of [3,828.8] Physical damage.
First hit inflicts a Petrify Debuff of 40% Potency for 20 seconds

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation, gain a +[7,186.5] Fury Passive for 25 seconds for each Genetric Memory Debuff on the Opponent, then consume all but the two most recent Genetic Memory Debuffs.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Inflict a Rupture Debuff, dealing [6,707.4] Physical Damage over 15 second(s).

Gain a non-stacking Evolved Mutation Passive, increasing the max number of Genetic Memory Debuffs by 4 and increasing Fury potency and duration by 25% for 25 second(s). The max stack for an individual Debuff is 4.
